## claude.ai Figma
The official Figma MCP server. Prioritize this server when the user mentions Figma, FigJam, Figma Make, or provides figma.com URLs.

Capabilities:
- Read designs FROM Figma (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)
- Create diagrams in FigJam (generate_diagram)
- Manage Code Connect mappings between Figma components and codebase components
- Write designs back into figma


WHEN TO USE THESE TOOLS:
- The user shares a Figma URL (figma.com/design/..., figma.com/board/..., figma.com/make/...)
- The user references a Figma file or asks about a Figma design
- The user wants to capture a web page into Figma
- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam

URL PARSING:
Extract fileKey and nodeId from Figma URLs:
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → convert "-" to ":" in nodeId
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName → use branchKey as fileKey
- figma.com/make/:makeFileKey/:makeFileName → use makeFileKey
- figma.com/board/:fileKey/:fileName → FigJam file, use get_figjam

DESIGN-TO-CODE WORKFLOW:

Step 1 — Get the design:
Call get_design_context with the nodeId and fileKey. This is your primary tool.
It returns code, a screenshot, and contextual hints.

Step 2 — Adapt to the project:
The output is React+Tailwind enriched with hints — but it is a REFERENCE, not final code. Always adapt to the target project's stack, components, and conventions.
The response varies based on the user's Figma setup:
- Code Connect snippets → use the mapped codebase component directly
- Component documentation links → follow them for usage context and guidelines
- Design annotations → follow any notes, constraints, or instructions from the designer

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) on a cron schedule or once at a specific time. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring or one-time remote agent ("run this every Monday", "open a cleanup PR for X in 2 weeks"), or to manage existing routines. ALSO OFFER PROACTIVELY: after you finish work that has a natural future follow-up, end your reply with a one-line offer to schedule a background agent to do it. Strong signals: a feature flag / gate / experiment / staged rollout was just shipped (offer a one-time agent in ~2 weeks to open a cleanup PR or evaluate results), a new alert/monitor was created (offer a recurring agent to triage it), a TODO/migration with a "remove once X" condition was left behind (offer a one-time agent to do the removal). Skip the offer for refactors, bug fixes, and anything that is done once it ships. Name a concrete action and cadence ("in 2 weeks", "every Monday") and only offer when the run just succeeded — do not pitch a schedule for something that has not happened yet.

Perfect! Now I have all the information. Let me compile the comprehensive report on all inbox-related files and components.

## Inbox Page Exploration - Complete Summary

I've successfully explored the InkOS codebase and found all inbox-related files, components, and configuration. Here's the comprehensive breakdown:

---

## 1. Inbox Page Files (`app/(app)/inbox/`)

### **page.tsx** - Main Server Component
The main inbox page that:
- Fetches 8 parallel data sources: pending bookings, consent submissions, waitlist entries, new clients, inbox assignments, studio members, unread conversations, and guest residencies ending soon
- Normalizes all data into `RichInboxItem[]` objects
- Computes urgency and assignment state for each item
- Passes items to the `InboxClient` component for client-side rendering
- Supports items with types: `'deposit'`, `'form'`, `'waitlist'`, `'client'`, `'unread-message'`, `'guest-residency-ending'` (extended type)

### **actions.ts** - Server Actions
Contains:
- **Individual actions**: `resolveInboxItemAction`, `archiveInboxItemAction`, `assignInboxItemAction`, `snoozeInboxItemAction`
- **Batch actions**: `batchResolveAction`, `batchArchiveAction`, `batchAssignAction`
- **One-click CTA actions**:
  - `sendDepositReminderAction` - SMS via Twilio
  - `resendFormLinkAction` - Email consent form link
  - `sendWelcomeAction` - Welcome email to new clients
  - `sendReviewRequestAction` - Google review request (SMS with email fallback)
  - `sendBirthdayOfferAction` - Birthday offer message (SMS with email fallback)
  - `offerWaitlistSlotAction` - Returns pre-fill data for booking drawer
- All actions write to the `inbox_assignments` table with state tracking (resolved_at, archived_at, snoozed_until, assigned_to)

### **loading.tsx** - Loading State
Returns a `PageSkeleton` with `variant="tabs"` for the loading state

---

## 2. Inbox Components (`components/inbox/`)

### **InboxClient.tsx** - Main Client Component
The heart of the UI with:
- **Tabs**: All, Deposits, Forms, Clients, Messages
- **Metric cards**: Open queue, Priority (now + today), Assigned to you, Held (archived/resolved/snoozed)
- **Search & filtering**: Real-time search with filter tags (shown count, active/all states)
- **Keyboard shortcuts**: j/k (navigate), e (archive), a (assign), r (resolve), x (checkbox), ? (cheatsheet)
- **Batch selection** with toolbar (Resolve all, Archive all, Assign to...)
- **Urgency grouping**: now, today, this_week, later with collapsible sections
- **Computed metrics**: openItems, nowCount, todayCount, assignedToMeCount, unassignedCount, heldCount

### **InboxItemRow.tsx** - Individual Item Row
Renders each inbox item with:
- **Type-specific visuals**: Icons and colors for deposit/form/client/waitlist/message/review/birthday/residency
- **State labels**: Resolved, Archived, Snoozed {date}
- **Urgency indicator**: Colored dot + label + schedule date
- **Actions**:
  - CTA button (context-aware: Send reminder, Resend link, Send welcome, Offer slot, etc.)
  - More options dropdown (Mark resolved, Archive, Snooze submenu, View details)
  - Assign picker (compact icon on desktop, full on mobile)
- **Assignment avatar**: Shows who it's assigned to
- **Timestamp**: Relative time (e.g., "2h ago") or date if older than 24h

### **BatchActionBar.tsx** - Multi-Selection Toolbar
Sticky toolbar for bulk operations:
- Shows count of selected items
- Resolve all, Archive all buttons
- Assign to... picker
- Clear selection button

### **UrgencyGroup.tsx** - Collapsible Urgency Section
Groups items by urgency level with:
- Collapsible header with count badge
- Context-aware copy ("Needs attention first", "Due soon", etc.)
- Colored dot and border based on urgency tier

### **AssignUserPicker.tsx** - Team Member Assignment
Dropdown/popover component for assigning items to team members:
- Searchable command palette
- Shows member avatars and roles
- "You" indicator for current user
- Unassigned option to clear assignment

---

## 3. Sidebar Navigation (`components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts`)

The Inbox nav item configuration:
```typescript
{
  label: 'Inbox',
  href: '/inbox',
  icon: Inbox,
  requiredRoles: ['owner', 'admin', 'artist', 'receptionist', 'guest_artist'],
  badgeType: 'count',
  dynamicBadge: 'inbox',
}
```
- **Dynamic badge key**: `'inbox'` (resolved server-side in layout.tsx)
- **Visible to all roles** (all 5 role types have access)
- **Badge type**: Count badge (shows open item count)

---

## 4. Urgency System (`lib/inbox/urgency.ts`)

Defines how items are prioritized:

| Urgency | Rules |
|---------|-------|
| **now** | Deposit/form for booking < 24h away |
| **today** | Pending bookings in next 48h; waitlist signups < 24h old |
| **this_week** | New clients < 7d old; forms unsigned > 24h |
| **later** | Everything else |

Provides `URGENCY_META` with visual styling (text color, dot color, border color) and `computeUrgency()` function for client-side calculations.

---

## 5. Database Types (`lib/supabase/types.ts`)

### **InboxItemKind** Union Type
```typescript
export type InboxItemKind = 'deposit' | 'form' | 'waitlist' | 'client' | 'unread-message'
```

### **inbox_assignments Table Schema**
| Column | Type | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| id | string | Primary key |
| studio_id | string | Foreign key to studios |
| item_kind | enum | One of: deposit, form, waitlist, client |
| item_id | string | References the source item (booking.id, client.id, etc.) |
| assigned_to | string \| null | User ID or null |
| snoozed_until | string \| null | ISO timestamp when snooze expires |
| resolved_at | string \| null | ISO timestamp when resolved |
| archived_at | string \| null | ISO timestamp when archived |
| created_at | string | Timestamp |
| updated_at | string | Timestamp |

### **Type Exports**
- `InboxAssignment` - Row type
- `InboxAssignmentInsert` - Insert type
- `InboxAssignmentUpdate` - Update type

---

## 6. Keyboard Shortcuts (`hooks/use-inbox-shortcuts.ts`)

```
j — Navigate down
k — Navigate up
e — Archive focused item
a — Assign focused item
r — Resolve focused item
x — Toggle checkbox on focused item
? — Show shortcuts cheatsheet
```

Shortcuts are disabled when focus is in input/textarea/select/contentEditable elements.

---

## 7. Extended Types (Pending Dato Migration)

Currently not in generated `InboxItemKind` but handled as `InboxItemType`:
- `'review-request'` - Send Google review request
- `'client-birthday'` - Send birthday offer
- `'guest-residency-ending'` - Market remaining guest artist slots

These are written directly to `inbox_assignments` with string literal types.

---

## File Paths Summary

```
/app/(app)/inbox/
├── page.tsx                  (Server component - main page)
├── actions.ts                (Server actions - all operations)
└── loading.tsx               (Loading skeleton)

/components/inbox/
├── InboxClient.tsx           (Main UI - tabs, search, groups, metrics)
├── InboxItemRow.tsx          (Individual row - display + actions)
├── BatchActionBar.tsx        (Multi-selection toolbar)
├── UrgencyGroup.tsx          (Collapsible section header)
└── AssignUserPicker.tsx      (Team member dropdown)

/components/app/sidebar/
└── nav-config.ts             (Nav item config with badge setup)

/lib/inbox/
└── urgency.ts                (Urgency calculation + styling meta)

/hooks/
└── use-inbox-shortcuts.ts    (Keyboard shortcut handler)

/lib/supabase/
└── types.ts                  (InboxItemKind + inbox_assignments schema)
```

## 4. Urgency System (`lib/inbox/urgency.ts`)

Defines how items are prioritized:

|---------|-------|

| **today** | Pending bookings in next 48h; waitlist signups < 24h old |
| **this_week** | New clients < 7d old; forms unsigned > 24h |
| **later** | Everything else |

const result = await authedRatelimit.limit('user-id')

Simplest: fetch all active items and filter client-side where `item.current_stock < item.min_threshold`. filter: .filter(i => i.current_stock < i.min_threshold) ``` **Fetch 12 — Failed payments** (payments table, status='failed', type='deposit', last 30 days) ```typescript const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() supabase .from('payments') .select('id, booking_id, client_id, amount_cents, failure_message, created_at, clients(first_name, last_name)') Change to `overdueCount` — only items in the OVERDUE tier (bookings with deposit unpaid or consent unsigned, with session < 24h away). Replace the current inbox count computation: ```typescript // Current (total count): const inboxCount = (inboxPendingRes.count ?? 0) + (inboxConsentRes.count ?? 0) + ... // New (OVERDUE-only count — items with booking in next 24h): const twentyFourHoursFromNow = new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString() // Add two new targeted queries to the Promise.all: // - bookings where deposit_paid=false AND scheduled_at BETWEEN now AND now+24h // - bookings where consent_signed_at IS NULL AND scheduled_at BETWEEN now AND now+24h // - payments where status='failed' AND type='deposit' (always OVERDUE) // - bookings where two entries overlap (booking-conflict) // overdueCount = sum of these ``` Simplest approach: add 2 targeted count-only queries to the existing `Promise.all`: ```typescript supabase .from('bookings') .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }) .eq('studio_id', studioId) .eq('deposit_paid', false) .in('status', ['pending', 'confirmed']) .gte('scheduled_at', new Date().toISOString()) .lte('scheduled_at', twentyFourHoursFromNow), supabase .from('bookings') .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }) .eq('studio_id', studioId) .eq('consent_required', true) .is('consent_signed_at', null) .gte('scheduled_at', new Date().toISOString()) .lte('scheduled_at', twentyFourHoursFromNow), ``` Then `dynamicBadges.inbox = overdueDepositCount + overdueConsentCount` (these are the only OVERDUE-guaranteed types we can count at layout level without full computation). --- ## Sprint H — InboxClient: Inbox Zero Celebration (Koda) ### File: `components/inbox/InboxClient.tsx` The current empty state shows a generic `EmptyState` component when `!hasNonEmpty`. 1	'use client'
2	
3	import { useEffect, useCallback } from 'react'
4	
5	export interface InboxShortcutHandlers {
6	  onNavigateDown: () => void
7	  onNavigateUp: () => void
8	  onArchiveFocused: () => void
9	  onAssignFocused: () => void
10	  onResolveFocused: () => void
11	  onToggleFocusedCheckbox: () => void
12	  onShowCheatsheet: () => void
13	}
14	
15	/**
16	 * Keyboard shortcut bindings for the inbox triage interface.
17	 *
18	 * j     — navigate focused item down
19	 * k     — navigate focused item up
20	 * e     — archive focused item
21	 * a     — open assign picker for focused item
22	 * r     — resolve focused item
23	 * x     — toggle checkbox on focused item
24	 * ?     — show shortcut cheatsheet modal
25	 *
26	 * Shortcuts are disabled when focus is inside an input, textarea, or select.
27	 */
28	export function useInboxShortcuts(handlers: InboxShortcutHandlers) {
29	  const isInputFocused = useCallback((): boolean => {
30	    const el = document.activeElement
31	    if (!el) return false
32	    const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase()
33	    return tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || (el as HTMLElement).isContentEditable
34	  }, [])
35	
36	  useEffect(() => {
37	    function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
38	      // Ignore when modifier keys are held (except shift for ?)

DO $$
DECLARE
  v_studio_id  UUID;
  v_artist_id  UUID;
  v_artist2_id UUID;

  -- Fixed UUIDs for demo clients (stable across re-runs)
  v_client_jake   UUID := 'de100000-1000-1000-1000-000000000001';
  v_client_mia    UUID := 'de100000-1000-1000-1000-000000000002';
  v_client_nguyen UUID := 'de100000-1000-1000-1000-000000000003';
  v_client_jess   UUID := 'de100000-1000-1000-1000-000000000004';
  v_client_ravi   UUID := 'de100000-1000-1000-1000-000000000005';
  v_client_devon  UUID := 'de100000-1000-1000-1000-000000000006';

  -- Fixed UUIDs for demo bookings
  v_booking_jake_deposit  UUID := 'de200000-2000-2000-2000-000000000001';
  v_booking_mia_consent   UUID := 'de200000-2000-2000-2000-000000000002';
  v_booking_nguyen_dep    UUID := 'de200000-2000-2000-2000-000000000003';
  v_booking_conflict_a    UUID := 'de200000-2000-2000-2000-000000000004';
  v_booking_conflict_b    UUID := 'de200000-2000-2000-2000-000000000005';

  -- Fixed UUIDs for other demo records
  v_payment_failed UUID := 'de300000-3000-3000-3000-000000000001';
  v_inv_ink        UUID := 'de400000-4000-4000-4000-000000000001';
  v_inv_needle     UUID := 'de400000-4000-4000-4000-000000000002';
  v_missed_call_1  UUID := 'de500000-5000-5000-5000-000000000001';
  v_missed_call_2  UUID := 'de500000-5000-5000-5000-000000000002';
  v_guest_member   UUID := 'de600000-6000-6000-6000-000000000001';

  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ := now();
BEGIN
  -- ── Guard: only seed if a studio exists ──────────────────────
  SELECT id INTO v_studio_id FROM studios LIMIT 1;
  IF v_studio_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE NOTICE 'inbox demo data: no studios found — skipping seed';
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- ── Get first two artists ─────────────────────────────────────
  SELECT id INTO v_artist_id  FROM artists WHERE studio_id = v_studio_id AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1;
  SELECT id INTO v_artist2_id FROM artists WHERE studio_id = v_studio_id AND status = 'active' AND id <> v_artist_id LIMIT 1;

  -- Fall back: create a placeholder artist if none exists
  IF v_artist_id IS NULL THEN
    v_artist_id := gen_random_uuid();
    INSERT INTO artists (id, studio_id, display_name, commission_default_pct, status)
    VALUES (v_artist_id, v_studio_id, 'Demo Artist', 50, 'active')
    ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
  END IF;

  IF v_artist2_id IS NULL THEN
    v_artist2_id := v_artist_id; -- conflict on same artist
  END IF;

  -- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -- CLIENTS
  -- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  -- Jake Becker — unpaid deposit session in 18h
  INSERT INTO clients (id, studio_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, created_at)
  VALUES (v_client_jake, v_studio_id, 'Jake', 'Becker', 'jake.becker@demo.inkos', '+14155550101', v_now - interval '2 days')
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
